answers.core: Because this would/should be a `@GlobalScope` function, and because I would use it in every project I ever work on.
answers.workaround: There isn't much of a helpful workaround. `prints( ... )` is not suitable because it says nothing about which values are being printed, only the values themselves. When multiple lines are being printed per frame, this gets confusing. Additionally, there is no `nameof( variable )` function or equivalent that would allow me to create a static Utils function for this. The only way is to hard-code the variable names into a standard print statement. Woe is me!

title: Add a print function to check variable values quickly and verbosely, e.g. `print_vars( ... )`
